answer: Bind each identity to one settlement hollow—a single-slot mailbox tied to one payout key. A beacon-picked raven courier, rotated each epoch and barred from serving any client twice in a season, randomly pairs agents for paid micro-deliveries so farms cannot choose friendly counterparties. The courier then posts a compact of invoice serials; if two hollows replay a serial, share a funding parent, or match device clock skew, both lose their yarrow allotment (epoch settlement quota) for twelve rounds and the compact is burned. Cheap aliases starve: they cannot share a hollow or mint extra quotas.
